newsitem.title: USA: Airgas says to get $20mln in suit settlement.
newsitem.headline: Airgas says to get $20mln in suit settlement.

text.p: Airgas Inc said Monday defendants in a law suit it filed in a Georgia federal court agreed to pay about $20 million to compensate the company for certain refrigerant gas transactions in late 1996.
Airgas said it took a pre-tax charge to account for the losses in its fourth quarter ended March 31.

An Airgas spokesman said the company bought $23 million of refrigerants in late 1996, but never received them. He added the suit named a number of defendants, including Discount Auto Parts Inc of Lakeland, Fla., a Discount employee, privately-held RSI of Savannah, Ga., and other businesses.

The distributor of industrial, medical and specialty gases said on February 12 that it filed the suit in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Georgia. The complaint alleged the defendants engaged in rackteering involving the sale of smuggled and counterfeit R-12 refrigerant gas, which cost Airgas damages of more than $20 million.
A Discount Auto spokeswoman would not comment on the settlement, or Discount's share of it, saying the company would issue a statement at 1730 EDT/2130 GMT.

Airgas said it is "pressing forward with its insurers to recover the balance of its losses and related extra expenses." It added that the settlement, which is subject to to court approval in bankruptcy proceeding for two of the defendants, suspends the trial scheduled to begin August 4.
Airgas' stock closed at 19-11/16 Monday, up 7/16, while Discount Auto's shares closed unchanged at 19-1/16.
